thread:
Evan: Day 4 check-in — got most env set up but hitting a blocker: VPN split-tunnel doesn't route to internal model registry (registry.redwood.local). I can ping 10.8.0.1 but `curl http://registry.redwood.local:8080` times out. Anyone seen this?

Priya: welcome! ok first pass — did you get the corp certs installed? `sudo update-ca-certificates` on your laptop? also make sure the IDP group 'redwood-onboard' is in your SSO profile.

Evan: I did the certs step earlier today, restarted docker. IDP group shows in Okta but still can't reach the registry.

Sam (infra): quick check — what's your VPN client? split-tunnel can drop DNS for internal names. If you're on macOS and using wireguard-based client, try `scutil --dns` to confirm resolvers. If DNS looks fine, run `sudo route -n get registry.redwood.local` and paste output.

Evan: running `scutil --dns` now — looks like resolver order is public first. route output:
```
route to: registry.redwood.local
  destination: 10.8.0.50
  interface: utun2
  flags: <UP,GATEWAY>
```
But `curl` still times out.

Jenna (eng-ml): also check if the registry is bound only to private VPC IPs and requires source IP in allowlist. Sometimes onboarding spans a NAT that needs a static egress. Sam can confirm.

Sam (infra): Evan — can you paste the output of `curl -v http://10.8.0.50:8080/health`? If that fails, try `telnet 10.8.0.50 8080` to see if TCP connects.

Evan: `telnet` hangs, so likely TCP blocked. I'm on home ISP, behind CGNAT. Is there a recommended workaround?

Sam (infra): If CGNAT is the issue, temporary workaround is to use our remote jumpbox. SSH into `jumpbox.redwood.com` (you have creds via idp). Once there, `curl http://registry.redwood.local:8080` should work. I'll open a support ticket to add your egress IP for a short window if you prefer.

Priya: Evan — here's the quick jumpbox command: `ssh -J evan@jumpbox.redwood.com -L 8080:10.8.0.50:8080 localhost -N` then visit `http://localhost:8080/` locally.

Evan: trying now — looks good! `/health` returns `ok`. Thanks 🙏. I'll run the onboard script to pull the model artifacts.

idp-bot: Your session with jumpbox.redwood.com was authenticated via Okta SSO (Evan). Session expires in 8 hours.

Jenna (eng-ml): once you pull artifacts, run the lightweight model container with `docker run --rm -p 9000:9000 local/model:dev` and sanity-check inference with `curl localhost:9000/encode -d 'text=hello'`. Ping me if scores look off.

Evan: will do. blockers cleared for now. Thanks everyone! :tada:
